title: Matibag gets US Secret Service recognition for $206M counterfeit haul
summary: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag has been recognized by the US Secret Service after the bureau seized $206 million worth of counterfeit US currency…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag has been recognized by the US Secret Service after the bureau seized $206 million worth of counterfeit US currency and financial instruments in Pasay City last March. A certificate of appreciation signed by US Secret Service Guam Resident Agent in Charge Amy Knowlton Baylon
